methodDefinitions.raw: Original uint16 intensities cast to float32 without rescaling
methodDefinitions.gaussian_1p5: 3D separable Gaussian sigma 1.5, finite radius 6, nearest boundary
methodDefinitions.tv800_16: Chambolle TV weight 800 original intensity units; exactly 16 iterations; eps=0
methodDefinitions.tv800_40: Chambolle TV weight 800 original intensity units; exactly 40 iterations; eps=0

metricNotes.triangles: skimage marching_cubes, Lewiner, allow_degenerate=False; counts may differ from NBE1 classic cases
metricNotes.components: 26-connected above-threshold voxel components inside the measured crop; includes crop-cut components
metricNotes.area: Extracted triangle area in native-voxel squared; an outcome measure, not an accuracy measure
metricNotes.sampling: 32 pre-existing stratified source blocks; not a random sample or organ-wide accuracy validation
metricNotes.timing: Single serial comparison during other work; filter times are descriptive, not controlled throughput benchmarks
